reviews.name: sounddevice
reviews.provenance: The PortAudio DLLs under _sounddevice_data/portaudio-binaries are shipped inside the installed sounddevice 0.5.6 wheel. Its README states that they were built automatically with GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/build-libs.yml) and credits PortAudio by Ross Bencina and Phil Burk under the MIT License.
reviews.unresolved: The wheel names PortAudio's MIT License but does not include the PortAudio license text itself. Only the x64 build with the default host APIs (libportaudio64bit.dll) is bundled; the ASIO builds, which credit the Steinberg ASIO SDK without stating its terms, are removed.
